parameters.content:
## Answer website leads in seconds and get a Telegram alert

**Who's it for**

Any small business that gets enquiries through a website form and answers them by hand: trades, clinics, garages, salons, agencies. Anyone whose enquiries arrive in an inbox nobody opens for hours.

**How it works**

In an inbox every enquiry looks the same. The one that can wait until Tuesday sits next to the one you lose by lunchtime.

1. **Lead comes in** — a webhook takes whatever your form posts.
2. **Clean the data** — name, email, phone and message are made predictable. A missing email but a phone number is still a customer, not spam.
3. **Read intent & score** — it works out what the message is about (emergency, quote, booking, service) and scores it on how urgent it sounds and how real it looks. Urgency is decided first, so "leaking since last night" can never be filed as a routine service. Sales pitches are checked before anything else, so they never reach your phone.
4. **Write the reply & the alert** — the visitor gets an answer by name, in your own words, and is asked for whatever is missing (an address, a phone number).
5. **Worth telling him?** — only leads above your score threshold buzz you.
6. **Tell the owner** — one Telegram message with the score, what they want and what is missing.
7. **Answer the visitor** — the reply goes back on the page, in about two seconds.

**How to set up**

1. Open **Read intent & score**. The top block is a plumber's word list — swap the words for your trade. Nothing else needs changing.
2. Open **Write the reply & the alert** and put your business name and phone at the top.
3. Add your Telegram credential to **Tell the owner** and put your own chat id in.
4. Copy the production URL from **Lead comes in** and post your form to it.

**Requirements**

A Telegram bot token and chat id. Nothing else. No AI account, no paid API, no per-message cost.

**How to customize**

The trade word list, the score threshold in **Worth telling him?**, and the wording of the reply are all plain lists at the top of the code nodes. Adding a trade is a line, not a rebuild.

It never promises anything on the customer's behalf: no callback times, no prices, no "an engineer is on the way". It answers, it collects what is missing, and it tells you.

## 1 · Take the enquiry
A webhook accepts whatever your form posts, then the data is made predictable: name, email, phone, message.

A missing email but a phone number is still a customer.

## 2 · Read it and score it
Urgency is decided FIRST, so a painful case can never be filed as routine.

Sales pitches are matched before anything else, so "we offer SEO services" never reaches the phone.

👉 Swap the word list at the top for your trade.

## 3 · Answer, then decide who to wake
The visitor is answered by name and asked for what is missing.

Only leads above the score threshold buzz the owner. Everything else is still answered.

👉 Put your business name and phone in the code node.

## Telegram
Add your own credential and chat id here.

Nothing is promised on the owner's behalf: no callback times, no prices.
